public_items.basis: S97; separate eastern private palace block, registered Domus Augustana upper court. Approx85x100m envelope; peristyle48x60m and12m wings estimated from this palace, not household fabric. Separate historic terrace, not independently grounded wings of Flavia. Its oversized southeast edge also crossed the sourced161x48m Palatine Stadium, so that half-wing recedes6.5m. Site anchor, inner court, north hall and other wings retained. Recess coordinates are plan-reading estimates, not an excavated113 wall survey.
